description: Off-by-one in range — generates wrong number of elements
traceback:
No exception raised.
Expected output: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
Actual output: [1, 2, 3, 4]
The function returns one fewer element than expected.

ground_truth.root_cause: range(1, n) goes up to n-1, not n — should be range(1, n+1) to include n
